We are a passionate, multidisciplinary team driven by space exploration, complex problem solving and technology 
Desafio N°1 "ABANDONADOS PERO NO OLVIDADOS"
Nuestro proyecto es una experiencia interactiva (videojuego) ambientada en la superficie lunar que fusiona la exploración espacial con la preservación histórica. A través de una narrativa inmersiva, invitamos a los usuarios a descubrir el legado olvidado de la exploración espacial
summary:
We developed "PATCHWORK LANDER," a space simulation and survival game set on the Moon and Mars. The story follows a group of astronauts whose return to Earth is jeopardized when their spacecraft’s life-support systems fail, severely limiting their oxygen supply. To survive, they must utilize two distinct types of rovers—the "R-LUNA" for the lunar mission and the "R-ARES" for the mission to Mars—tasked with salvaging specific components from abandoned modules left behind on these celestial bodies, ultimately ensuring the crew’s safe return.
 The simulation explores the legacy of what were once humanity’s most advanced technological achievements. Rather than viewing these abandoned modules as mere obsolete junk, the game treats them as invaluable treasures for science and research, highlighting their historical significance and the stories they hold.
"PATCHWORK LANDER" offers a unique experience, allowing users to rediscover inventions that once played a fundamental role in aerospace engineering—and in our own lives. It transforms an educational narrative into an immersive survival and interactive experience, reconnecting players with historical artifacts that had long been forgotten and bringing them back into the light.
details:
The video game unfolds as follows: the user controls a robotic rover across two distinct settings—the Moon and Mars—tasked with locating various abandoned modules left behind on these celestial bodies. The player must extract parts from these modules to repair their own spacecraft. Throughout this journey, the game aims to provide an interactive experience, allowing the user to discover how these modules arrived there and the specific missions they were originally intended to carry out during their operational lifespan. Patchwork Lander aims to demonstrate that even modules that have been abandoned—or were perhaps never widely known—can be repurposed to continue benefiting humanity. The project is creative because it breathes new life into modules and spacecraft from past space missions. Rather than focusing solely on future technology, the game encourages players to leverage great inventions from the past to save their crew, turning space history into the primary tool for survival. The key factors we considered for this project include:
.Historical Narrative: We researched actual missions to the Moon and Mars to select authentic spacecraft and rovers, ensuring that the components make logical sense and illustrating how these vital probes can be repaired.
.Real-world planetary conditions: We accounted for the differences in gravity, terrain, and environments between the Moon and Mars when designing the movement and structure of the R-LUNA and R-ARES vehicles.
.Resource management and tension: We balanced oxygen consumption rates to ensure players feel time-based pressure as they carry out their mission.
.Accessibility for all: We designed accessible gameplay so that everyone—from space enthusiasts to children—can explore and enjoy the activities within the game.
The benefits of this project are both educational and inspirational, transforming space history into an interactive experience between the simulator and the user.
Some of these benefits include:
.Learning through play: Instead of reading long texts, players discover real historical missions and learn how spacecraft components function while striving to survive.
• Valuing space heritage: We aim to raise awareness of the immense value of historical modules on the Moon and Mars, encouraging people to view them as significant human achievements rather than forgotten objects.
• Inspiring future explorers: The game seeks to spark curiosity about science, technology, and space exploration in people of all ages.
